title: Normalized Gysin support chart and canonical restriction
statement:
The canonical support chart of lem-pur-gysin-structure together with the actual
snake boundary. The formulas fix both the identification and its sign; none of the
maps is an unconstrained support isomorphism.

Its exact Lean specification is: structure OrientationSupportData (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) (h : P.ramificationIndex ∣ P.level) (Y : Scheme.{u})

Notions: [def-pur-conventions], [lem-pur-gysin-structure], [def-pur-support-boundary-normalization], [lem-pur-supported-hom-pullback]. The same module defines its coordinateBoundary by applying its normalized boundary to gysinKummerSection, orientationInputPullback by the canonical comparison and root-line pullback, and orientationSupportRestriction by right-derived support-kernel transport followed by this coefficient pullback. These four declarations retain their signatures; the chart, boundary and restriction map are moved verbatim, while the coefficient pullback wrapper uses the definitionally equal shared coordinateProCoefficientPullback implementation.
